reviews.text: I am always delighted with the service! Cameron is always on time, efficient and informative. He came at the time promised and quickly took care of the job. I'm impressed by the consistent high quality service. Highly recommends!
reviews.author: Beverly Neumann

reviews.text: I love these people!  They are so nice and personable.  On top of that, they do an amazing job on our pool.  Very reliable and wonderfully priced.
reviews.author: Kimberly Eubanks

reviews.text: Excellent service! Highly recommend KLEEN for all your pool needs. They came out last minute when another company was ghosting me. They cleaned our filters and educated us on the cleaning process and need for regular cleaning. Will continue to use their service!
reviews.author: Susan Sinyard

reviews.text: So easy to get a hold of, especially with a horrible algae problem.  Responds to questions quickly and very knowledgeable.  Great price for a clean up!!!! Cameron is great!
reviews.author: Fred Nordt

reviews.text: Cameron is fantastic to work with. We had an issue with our pump and he was here within an hour of us reaching out and fixed the problem.
reviews.author: Brian Edlund

reviews.text: You could not ask for a friendlier and honest service than what Cameron provide us. My go to from now on for pool maintenance needs.
reviews.author: Mike Schreckenghaust

reviews.text: We contacted Kleen Water Pool Service on Thursday evening in relation to our Pool pump being stuck in remote mode. It was urgent to us due to having company visiting over the 4th of July. Cameron and his wife came out Saturday morning even though they are closed on Saturdays. Within 2.5 hrs he had our pool up and running with a new pool pump installed. They both were professional and went out of their way to get our pool back up and running. I would definitely recommend them for your pool needs and will use Kleen Water Pool Service for any future repairs. Thank you so much!!
reviews.author: CHRISTINA Schreckenghaust

reviews.text: Cameron and his Kleen Water team are on top of things and work to ensure their service meets client needs. After install of a new cleaner pump Cameron has ensurebthebsmallnissuesbibhad werevaffressed and stood behind all warranties. It is great to have someone like him and hisbteam as part of my pool team.  Thank you Cameron!
reviews.author: Vance Clarke

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The perfect 5.0 rating is supported by detailed, credible reviews from real customers describing specific, urgent pool service scenarios. The low volume is explained by the business being only 1 year old. There are no complaints or negative patterns. Warranty follow-through is explicitly mentioned and positive.
fake_signals: Low review volume (8) for a perfect 5.0 rating
Multiple reviews posted within the same month (a month ago)
authentic_signals: Specific details: crew names (Cameron), project types (pump repair, filter cleaning, algae cleanup), timelines (urgent 4th of July repair)
Emotional authenticity: mentions of last-minute help, ghosting by other companies, working on a Saturday
Mix of praise and specific outcomes, not just generic praise
data.discrepancy_explanation: No contradictory ratings found. Google shows perfect 5.0, BBB shows a solid A- with no complaints. Yelp and other platforms show no negative ratings. The business is new (1 year old), which explains the low review volume.
